Relaxed, confident posture with a subtle smirk.

SUBJECT DETAILS
Lean build, natural proportions.
Hair slightly messy with soft bangs falling over forehead.
Expression calm, confident.

High contrast but smooth falloff.
No harsh shadows on face.

Strong cinematic contrast, bold and heroic tone.

Ultra-sharp focus on face and hat.
Background stays slightly flat and graphic (not realistic depth).
